decisions.evidence: Read all seven proof steps and exact supplier statements, including the full current two-marginal reversibility-implies-invariance proof. Bounded measurable alpha makes a,r measurable and covers acceptance endpoints 0 and 1. Each accepted section is a measure and each rejection term is a scaled point mass; their sum has mass one at every x, including pi-null rows. Diagonal pushforward R is well-defined without requiring the diagonal subset to be measurable. The joint-law integral identity gives J_P=eta+R on every product-measurable set. Swap preimages preserve disjoint unions, so eta^T is a measure dominated by both proposal flows; greatestness and involution give eta^T=eta. R is symmetric because swap fixes the diagonal map. The invariant-law supplier therefore applies with exactly its pointwise probability-kernel hypotheses. Empty state space is excluded by the target probability. No hidden irreducibility, uniqueness or convergence assumption is used. The reader expansion of the pushforward measure check is elementary audit enrichment, not a mathematical defect.
